sql: SELECT o.market_ticker, o.fill_model, o.policy, o.capital_tier_usd::text AS tier, count(*)::text AS n, round(sum(o.est_reward_usd),6)::text AS est_reward_sum, round(sum(o.capital_hours)::numeric,3)::text AS cap_hours FROM incentive_shadow_outcomes o WHERE o.market_ticker IN ('KXUSLEI-26SEP18-T0.2','KXTRUMPAPPROVE-26SEP18-E39.4','KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26-6.8','KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26-7.0','KXAAAGASDAZ-26SEP18-4.6800','KXYTVIEWSHIGH-POS26OCT-8.75M','KXHORMUZPEAK-26SEP20-T20','KXHORMUZPEAK-26SEP20-T25','KXHORMUZPEAK-26SEP20-T30') GROUP BY o.market_ticker, o.fill_model, o.policy, o.capital_tier_usd ORDER BY o.market_ticker, o.fill_model LIMIT 40
